# Konthora — extended reference

> Expanded companion to [llms.txt](/llms.txt). Contains the complete voice
> catalogue, format details, limits, and per-language breakdowns.
> Konthora is a free browser-based AI audio studio: text-to-speech with 41
> neural voices across 6 languages, plus audio/video transcription with
> sentence, paragraph, or word-level timestamps.

## Core facts

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Pricing | Free, no account required |
| Text limit | 2,000 characters per synthesis job |
| Upload limit | 100 MB and 10 minutes per transcription job |
| Speech output | MP3, WAV |
| Transcript output | TXT, SRT, VTT, JSON |
| Speech speed range | 0.75x to 1.25x, default 1.0x |
| Sentence pause | Configurable, default 220 ms |
| Paragraph pause | Configurable, default 500 ms |
| Transcription language | English |
| Transcription timestamp modes | sentence, paragraph, word |
| Accepted upload formats | MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, MP4, WebM, MOV |
| Voices | 41 total across 6 languages |
| Retention | Scripts wiped after synthesis; uploads and transcripts deleted after 60 minutes |

## Voice catalogue (41)

Voice IDs are stable and usable directly in the workspace. Recommended voices
are the default pick for their language.

### English (28)

American English (14): af_heart (Heart, female, recommended), af_alloy (Alloy,
female), af_aoede (Aoede, female), af_nicole (Nicole, female), af_nova (Nova,
female), af_river (River, female), af_sarah (Sarah, female), af_sky (Sky,
female), am_adam (Adam, male, recommended), am_echo (Echo, male), am_eric (Eric,
male), am_fenrir (Fenrir, male), am_liam (Liam, male), am_onyx (Onyx, male),
am_puck (Puck, male), am_santa (Santa, male).

British English (5): bf_emma (Emma, female, recommended), bf_alice (Alice,
female), bf_isabella (Isabella, female), bf_lily (Lily, female), bm_lewis
(Lewis, male, recommended).

### Spanish (3)

ef_dora (Dora, female), em_alex (Alex, male), em_santa (Santa, male).

### Portuguese, Brazilian (3)

pf_dora (Dora, female), pm_alex (Alex, male), pm_santa (Santa, male).

### Hindi (4)

hf_alpha (Alpha, female), hf_beta (Beta, female), hm_omega (Omega, male),
hm_psi (Psi, male).

### French (1)

ff_siwis (Siwis, female) — the only native French voice.

### Italian (2)

if_sara (Sara, female), im_nicola (Nicola, male).

Per-voice detail pages live at `https://konthora.dev.bd/voices/{voice-id}` where
`{voice-id}` is the ID with the underscore replaced by a hyphen, for example
`af_heart` -> https://konthora.dev.bd/voices/af-heart.

## Tools

### Text to Speech — https://konthora.dev.bd/text-to-speech

1. Select a language, then a voice.
2. Paste up to 2,000 characters of script.
3. Optionally adjust speed (0.75x-1.25x), sentence/paragraph pauses, and text
   normalization.
4. Generate, then download as MP3 or WAV.

Language-specific entry points: `/text-to-speech/spanish`, `/hindi`,
`/french`, `/italian`, `/portuguese`.

### Audio to Text — https://konthora.dev.bd/audio-to-text

1. Upload audio or video (100 MB / 10 minutes max).
2. Choose sentence, paragraph, or word-level timestamps.
3. Transcribe, review and edit inline with undo.
4. Export as TXT, SRT, VTT, or JSON, individually or bundled as a ZIP.

Format-specific entry points: `/mp3-to-text`, `/video-to-text`.

### Text to MP3 — https://konthora.dev.bd/text-to-mp3

Compact MP3 export for narration and sharing.

## Models

- Kokoro — the open-weight TTS model behind speech generation:
  https://konthora.dev.bd/entity/kokoro
- Whisper (faster-whisper `small.en`, CPU int8) — the transcription model:
  https://konthora.dev.bd/entity/whisper
